title: Filing an appeal to the National Commission

content.scenario: A consumer in India has received an order from the State Commission, and they want to appeal it to the National Commission. The National Commission is satisfied that the case involves a substantial question of law.
content.outcome: The National Commission will consider the appeal and make a decision based on the substantial question of law.

user_queries: How to file an appeal to the National Commission?
What is the process for filing an appeal to the National Commission?
Can I appeal an order from the State Commission to the National Commission?
